_doc: greenroom registry. Families group hidden skills behind one visible gate. 'skills' starts empty: `sync` fills it by keyword matching and keeps it current. Move a skill between families by editing this file; the PostToolUse hook re-syncs. keep_visible: never hidden. pending: new skills with no clear family (left visible until you place them). manual=true means you wrote the gate's SKILL.md yourself; greenroom then only writes references/skills-added.md next to it.
notes: Before spawning subagents or workflows, load any orchestration skill you have (e.g. symphony:orchestrating-subagents).
